title: Make the homepage route mathematically ordered and spatially layered
objective: Replace the apparently random top-to-bottom homepage beam with a centered deterministic harmonic curve and let it pass through three real artwork depth levels.
non_goals: tree, cave, root, or water geometry
acceptance_checks: route begins at the horizontal center at the top of the homepage
route x-position is derived only from a documented deterministic harmonic formula
route crosses behind, within, and in front of the artwork in intentional alternating bands
content and focus indicators remain above every route layer
category color appears only at its existing locally anchored activation segment

result.summary: The homepage route now starts at the horizontal center and is derived solely from two fixed sine harmonics. It alternates through front, interstitial, and back artwork bands while preserving local category activation color and keeping content above every route layer.
checks: zero-consumer scan for replaced route builder and SVG hooks

reviews.orchestrator_semantics_accessibility_rev: pass: the route remains decorative and aria-hidden; all content and focusable UI stay above its local artwork layers.
reviews.orchestrator_visual_integration_review: pass: the route visibly begins at the center, follows a repeatable harmonic rhythm, and alternates between front, interstitial, and behind-artwork bands.
